content.title: Complete WrestleMania results: WrestleMania match grades for every match
content.text: Updated April 18, 2026, 9:58 p.m. ETIt's the first half of the best weekend of the year. At least for pro wrestling fans.WrestleMania 42 kicks off tonight with the first night of action live from Las Vegas. We'll be with you from start to finish breaking down the matches, giving results, updates and opinions. So either watch alone or if you're not able to, follow along with all the action. It's WrestleMania! Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton gradeIt was good. I wanted more Pat McAfee. I wanted Randy Orton to win. I'm tired of Cody Rhodes. But it was a good match. Grade: 89 out of 100. Cody Rhodes defeats Randy OrtonCody keeps the title. I think this means Pat McAfee is out of WWE. Orton jumps him after the match, smashes him with the title. Now Cody is busted open too. Orton throws the belt down and punts Rhodes. He's at least in concussion protocol. Weird main event. Good guy wins, bad guy turns bad? Cody Rhodes vs. Randy OrtonI hear voices, and they're telling me we have a new champion on deck. Now let's address Pat McAfee. Why don't we like him? I get Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton doesn't need this. But how does it hurt? McAfee checks the boxes that make me want him here. He's a great talker, he's not here for a paycheck, he actually loves this, and people will watch for him. He's very popular. Kids love him. He's one of the biggest stars in sports. He doesn't take away from the match. He's ketchup on the fries. I'm here for Orton and Rhodes, but I am happy Pat is here. McAfee is pretty much every wrestling fan out there. He is living his dream. And he's a great entertainer. I'm a hardcore wrestling fan. It would infuraite me when people would show up and not look like they care. That's not McAfee. He loves this.And McAfee is out first. Not sure I like him getting his own enterence, but I understand it. Give the fans a chance to tell him he sucks. I'll take it. Randy Orton is out next. Of the blonde haired good guys Randy Orton has wrestled the past two years at WrestleMania, I only believe in one of them.To steal a line from Bobby Heenan, by the time Randy Orton gets to the ring, it's going to be WrestleMania 84. Pat McAfee waited for Randy Orton longer than it would take the Sandman get to the ring, and he would drink a six pack en route. Orton hasn't had one. This is my way of shouting out the Sandman. He was one of the most unique wrestlers to ever compete in this sport. He retired this weekend. Congrats, Sandman!Orton's song is still playing. I'm not kidding, it's been going for 20 minutes. Maybe not that long, but it played at least three times. Now it's time for the champ. I really hope Jelly Roll doesn't get his own enterence. Cody's hype video includes clips of his debut, Dashing Cody Rhodes, Stardust, and now the American Nightmare. Cody is out now with a mask. He's smoking too. Hey, I said mask and smoking. Somebody stop me!He's en route to the ring. He's dressed in a gold robe and mask, white tights. Looks sharp. Cody takes time to visit his wife and daughter. Does he think this is open mic night? Very cool. I like that wrestlers now acknowledge their families. The families sacrifice a lot, give them their spotlight. His wife got way more hate from some wrestling fans than she deserved when she was in AEW. I thought she was pretty good.Pat McAfee takes the mic, calls the fans disgusting pigs, then says make noise for Randy Orton. McAfee called us fat ass bums. That's hurtful. I've been so nice about him. Then they announce Cody Rhodes and we're off.McAfee lands the first blow with a microphone and now Cody is fighting back. Rhodes hit a CrossRhodes on McAfee. So he's done. He threw McAfee outside the ring, now he's setting him up on the table. McAfee is on the table. Jelly Roll is going on the table, and he puts McAfee through the table. Goodbye McAfee. Jelly Roll says give us the one on one fight we came to see. I didn't come to see a one on one fight. I wanted to see McAfee interfere.McAfee is going to be stretchered out. I hope he Willis Reed's in a half hour and against doctor's orders and all odds, he leads Orton to victory. That's what I want! I want him limping out, arms over two guys as he struggles to get to the ring. We need that.The fans are chanting "You deserve it." McAfee was right. Disgusting pigs! He gives a thumbs up on way out. McAfee is the greatest! Now it's Orton vs. Rhodes.Orton and Rhodes have locked up and Orton hits an uppercut and then goes to work on Cody's arm. But Cody comes back and goes for a Codycutter. Instead, Orton hits his backbreaker, and it hurt Randy more than Cody. But Randy goes to the eyes before Cody can recover. He puts in a chinlock as he tries to recover.Cody hits a suplex, and Orton favors his back. Michael Cole and Wade Barrett are talking about how Orton had a bad back coming in. Now that they're back in the ring, Cody is going to work on the back. He locks on a halfcrab.While Orton escaped, he isn't escaping punishment. He's now being thrown corner to corner. Orton tries to leave the ring, but Cody brings him back.Cody slapped on a bearhug. Cody keeps working on the back. He's not letting up. He hits a suplex, giving more punishment to the back. Orton is hurting.Cody went to the top rope, but Orton crotched him atop the turnbuckle. Orton landed a top rope superplex and that was dumb. Not a good move to do when you have a bad back. It's fine if you have a broken arm though. I've seen it done by a guy in a cast before.Orton hits a DDT and now Orton is looking for an RKO. He's so hurt, he can't bang the mat. He missed the RKO. Randy thrown outside, Cody goes for a dive and Orton punches him. Randy couldn't take control and Cody fights back. Are the fans booing Cody?Orton is busted wide open! And Rhodes is going after the cut. He's gushing. And Rhodes is kicking away. Orton is asking for mercy, but he's getting none. But he can only get a two count. Stay down, Randy.Cody is starting to feel bad, but he's going to work on the cut. Cody throws Randy outside, but he can't move. Randy is hurt! Cody goes for a drapping DDT. And he hits it. Cole keeps saying Rhodes is enjoying it. I don't think he is. He looks like he doesn't want to do it.Cody is calling for an RKO. But Orton hits a Crossrhodes. Cody kicks out at 2. Orton is bleeding and the blood is caking on his face. Orton goes for an RKO, but Cody hits one on Randy. Two count only.Rhodes lets ORton roll to the outside. And Rhodes is bouncing his head off the table. He does the Orton suplex on the table. Back in the ring, Rhodes calls for the end. He waits for Orton to get up and of course and RKO out of nowhere. But Rhodes kicks out.Orton and Rhodes are both hurt. Only Orton is bloody. They're going toe to toe, blow for blow. Cody poked Randy in the eye, Orton RKOs referee Charles Robinson. Cody kicks Randy in the nuts after Randy tried to do the same to the champ. Cody goes for a Cody Cutter, but Orton intercepts him with an RKO. McAfee is running out with a ref shirt on. And a neckbrace. But Cody kicked out. Classic Pat!Orton is laughing, but he shouldn't be. Orton RKOed McAfee. Cody CrossRhodes Orton. Cody retains. Biance Belair returnsThe EST was out next. Very cool, she's been out with an injury. She's a great wrestler, WWE is better having her out there, but she's also one of the best people, I'm told. I haven't met many jerk wrestlers, but she comes off as one of the absolute best people. Not nicest wrestlers, nicest people.She's dancing, no idea why she's there yet. I hope she's back. Can't spell WrestleMania without EST. She said it's been a long time since she's been around, she thanks fans for their support. She's getting emotional. She said you can't have WrestleMani without a surprise. Biance announces she's pregnent. Very, very cool! Congrats Bianca Belair and her husband Montez Ford!Very cool segment. She looks so happy. She gets a big hug from Cena, who then corrects the attendence. He added one for the baby. WrestleMania attendenceJohn Cena returns before the main event to announce the attendence. He said he would have bet the over because there are people everywhere. That's thanks to Pat McAfee, who lowered prices. 50,820 people are in the stadium. Not a bad crowd. Liv Morgan vs. Stephanie VaquerGood match. I liked that Liv won, she's going to be the biggest star going forward, but it didn't get out of first gear. Grade: 81 out of 100. Liv Morgan defeates Stephanie VaquerDaddy Dom comes out to celebrate as Liv Morgan is very emotional after winning. She celebrates with Dom Mysterio, Raquel Rodriguez and Roxanne Perez. She said she's the greatest champ of all time. Liv Morgan vs. Stephanie VaquerNext up is the women's championship match. Liv Morgan gave us a live action video on her way to the ring with her new song. Next up is Stephanie Vaquer. Morgan is sitting on the apron, almost like Raven. It looks cool. She has a black eye and a bruise on the face, but she looks ready. Vaquer does too. Should be a fun match.After a quick start, Liv takes control and she is pounding away and disrespecting Vaquer. She hits the three amigos and does the Eddie shuffle. But it's not enough to get the win. She goes for a frog splash, but she gets caught with two boots. Now Vaquer is in control and she hits the Devil's kiss on Liv. Then she hit a facebreaker on Liv, which can't feel good with the face already banged up. Liv avoided the package powerbomb, and hits a backstabber. That was cool. Liv went for the Devils Kiss of her own, but Vaquer stopped it.Vaquer hits an obLivian on Liv, but she escapes at two. Vaquer went for a moonsault, the ref was distracted by Roxanne Perez, Raquel Rodriguez clotheslined Vaquer on the top rope, Liv hits an Oblivian, but only gets two. Liv tried another obLivian, but she missed and landed on her teammates. Vaquer follows up with a huge spash on Rodriguez and Perez.Morgan hits a codebreaker and another obLivian and we have a new champion. CM Punk feature between matchesBefore we get to the two big matches, we have a feature on CM Punk. Perhaps this could have run on the six-hour preshow, but I like Punk. A shame he's gonna get smashed tomorrow. ESPN App blowsI'm not sure if it's Comcast or the app itself, but I'm watching WrestleMania and every time it goes to a commercial, it freezes. At $30 a month, you'd think you wouldn't get so many ads. This really is a disgrace. It's not hard to fix, you sign out and sign back in, but it also went out during the IC title match and took a while to get back on. Peacock never had these problems. WWE Hall of Famers honoredThey introduce the members of the hall of fame, including Demolition, Dennis Rodman, the family of Bad News Brown and Sid Viscious, then they bring out AJ Styles and the headliner, Stephanie McMahon. Hulk Hogan's family and Jimmy Hart are also there for the Hogan-Andre the Giant match being included. Gunther vs. Seth Rollins gradeThis was the best match thus far, and it came with a side of Bron Breakker. That's what we wanted. Grade: 95 out of 100.Gunther defeats Seth RollinsAfter getting speared by Bron Breakker, Set Rollins couldn't recover. Gunther locked on the sleeper and Rollins can't answer. Good match. As Rollins was leaving, Bron Breakker hit another spear. WWE's deep roster is only getting deeper. Breakker is embraced by Paul Heyman, so I guess we know who the Paul Heyman guy going forward is. Gunther vs. Seth RollinsWe're getting back to back matches with massive stars with Gunther coming out first to take on Seth Rollins. This is Rollins' first match since getting injured at Crown Jewel in October. Tonight, he'll take on a guy who has been very busy ending careers.Oh, before this match, good luck to the Flyers, my favorite team growing up. I stopped watching hockey during the strike years ago, but I really would like to see the Flyers win a Cup before I die. It probably won't be this year, but let's hope soon! They start at 8 p.m. on ESPN.Seth Rollins is out next and hel looks focused. This match includes two of the best wrestlers in the world and I expect a classic. This could be the best match of the weekend.Fans are behind Rollins. Not sure why, he's still a bad guy, right? His jacket is smoking. That's better than a light up jacket! And I love light up jackets. It's time to break this wall down.Gunther starts hot, hitting a suplext and a powerbomb right as the bell rings. Great job by Gunther, don't let Rollins get any momentum. Put doubt in his mind. Did he come back too early? He can't be sharp. Rollins spills to the outside and he and Gunther are tearing each other apart. Both men are using whatever they can get their hands on, chairs, tables, everything. Now both guys are back in the ring and they're throwing hands. Apparently the bell hadn't rung yet.Gunther slaps on a sleeper early, changes it into a belly to back suplext but Rollins lands on his feet and takes control. He hits the stomps like Bryan Danielson does, but before he can hit his trademark stomp, Gunther recovers. Now he's in control, but Seth cuts him off with a chop.It's very odd, but you don't see guys take control for long anymore. A lot different than back in the day where the good guy would do well, then get beat up, then win. You can't predict what's going to happen anymore.Gunther continues to pound away on Rollins, but Rollins battles back. These guys are just throwing everything at each other, and Gunther hits a powerbomb out of nowhere, but only gets a two count.Gunther now is firmly in control and Rollins is starting to fade. He's been hit with big blows, big moves and massive chops. Rollins tried a pedigree, but couldn't hit it. However, he hits a superkick, goes for it again, Gunther powers out with a back body drop, but Rollins holds on and finally hits the pedigree. Then a stomp but only gets a two count. Gunther is double tough.Rollins climbs to the top and goes for a stomp, but Gunther moved. He tried for a rollup, Gunther pushed him off and slaps on the sleeper. Rollins powered out of it. HIts a spinning forearm. Went for a second, but Gunther hits a clothesline from the bad part of hell. He climbs the top, but Rollins meets him up and hits his superplex into a Falcon Arrow. He only gets a 2 count, but then he slaps on a sleeper. Gunther is fading. He escapes to the outside and Rollins hits a dive. Then another. He goes for a third and he's caught. He gets powerbomed on the apron, then on the edge of the table. He goes for a third on the table, but Gunther can't hit it. Instead, Gunther is pedigreed on the table. Then Rollins hits a stomp on the table. He needs to get him in the ring. But Bron Breakker returns! He hits a spear!Gunther returns to the ring where Rollins is down and Gunther locks on a sleeper. Rollins is fading. He can't respond. This match is over. Gunther defeats Seth Rollins. Becky Lynch pins AJ LeeLynch cheated, I saw the replay, she took off the top turnbuckle, rammed AJ's head into it, hit her finisher and won. Looked like a decent match. I can't grade it, I didn't see it. Thanks ESPN (or Xfinity, I'm watching on their cable. I'm very disappointed in one of you!). Becky Lynch vs. AJ LeeThe Wonder Years plays Becky Lynch to the ring as the Man has come around. She's been better in this "run" than when she became the man. Totally different, but whatever Becky Lynch does, she does great. Now AJ Lee is out with a bunch of kids dressed just like her. This is awesome. One of the girls is shaking hands with all the fans, she's a natural!We are off! Both women are trading blows, going back and forth. They've had great matches, and I expect this to be no different.My ESPN shut down, when I got it back, I saw Lynch hit a manhandle slam and win the IC title. That was very disappointing, I was looking forward to that match. Oh well, Becky Lynch wins. Women's Fatal Fourway gradPaige is back, all eight ladies put on a show and we have new champs. Can't beat that. Grade: 92 out of 100. Bria Bella and Paige win tag team championshipThe win was nice. The return was way nicer. Great win, Paige is back where she wants to be -- in the ring. And it was a good match. Alexas Bliss, Charlotte Flair vs. Bayley, Lyra Valkyra, vs. the Bellas vs. Lash Legend, Nia JaxCharlotte and Alexa are out first. Lyra and Bayley are out next. The champs are out next. That's strange. I guess because the Bellas are hall of famers? Lash and Nia are wearing white, but have demolition masks on. Looks like an homage to Jason, but it's Demolition. You can see the cloth on the back. They are ready to wrestle. The Bellas are out next, but Nikki is on crutches. She said she isn't medically cleared. But she didn't want to ruin WrestleMania. She calls out Pagie!Michael Cole yell she's back! And she is. SHe is headed to the ring. And the fans are excited. This was a big return and the fans are treating it as such. Very cool.This match is all four women in ring at same time, so we'll do our best. Jax is starting out and she's taking it to Alexa, but Charlotte Flair hits a high cross body. Now Flair is taking it to everyone. Bella does her kicks to Lyra and Charlotte. I can say Bella because she's the only one there.Lyra and Bayley are ganging up on Alexa, but Legend breaks up the count. The fans want Paige, but she's yet to get in the ring. Brie hits a missle dropkick, can she make the tag? She does! Paige hits a series of clotheslines, then a fishermen's suplex.Paige hits her finsher on Lyra, but Bayley saves it. Jax hits a Samoan drop on Bayley, then she tumbles to the ground with Bella. Now it's Charlotte and Paige. Two old friends. Flair went for the figure 8, Paige hits a small package. Flair hits natural selection, Bliss goes for Twisted Bliss, Paige gets knees up, hits her finish and wins. Paige returnsPaige, known as the Anti-Diva and one of the most popluar female wrestlers in WWE history returned to the promotion Saturday at WrestleMania.Paige, who left the promotion in 2022, went on to wrestle for AEW before returning Saturday in the women's tag team championship bout.She teamed with Brie Bella to take on Charlotte Flair and Alexas Bliss, Bayley and Lyra Valkyra and tag team champions Lash Legend and Nia Jax. Nikki Bella was unable to wrestle due to an ankle injury.Paige is a two-time WWE champion, and both times she defeated AJ Lee for the title.Her return is great news for her fans, not just because she's back in WWE, but she's able to compete. Paige was deemed medically disqualified from competing in WWE due to neck injuries, but clearly that has changed.WrestleMania head to ESPN appWe head to the ESPN app for the final matches of the night. We will start with the ladies tag team match. Usos, LA Knight vs. Austin Theory, Logan Paul, IShowSpeed gradeI expected a different match and I was hoping for a Tom Brady run in. It didn't happen, but it was still a lot of fun. Was hoping for a 1D on Speed, but we had a great match with post match fun. Grade: 84 out of 100. The Usos, LA Knight beat Austin Theory, Logan Paul, IShowSpeedAfter the match, Logan Paul attacks Speed for costing them the match. He punches him and lays him on the table. Now Paul is lookig into the ring. He rolls in and climbs the ropes. Before he can hit his move, the Usos hit Paul with 1D. Then Knight picks up Speed and rolls him in the ring.Knight puts Paul on the table and the Usos help Speed climb the top rope. Speed stood on the post, milked it and hit a massive frogsplash, putting Paul through the table. The fans are going nuts. They roll speed in the ring, he looks dazed, and the fans go nuts for him. Jacob Fatu vs. Drew McIntyreThis feud could continue and I'd have no problem with it. They beat the heck out of each other and both deserve kudos. Grade: 91 out of 100. Jacob Fatu vs. Drew McIntyreThey'll be sore tomorrow. And probably are right now. They used weapons, their bodies and tore each other apart. Fatu gets the win and McIntyre gets banged up. Good match. Jacob Fatu vs. Drew McIntyreIf you ask me, this match features two of the biggest stars in WWE. I imagine they'll pull out all the stops because after this match, we head to ESPN Unlimited only. This is the match WWE will use to sell subs. I'm not sure they could pick two better guys. They showed Jahmyr Gibbs, Tyrese Haliburton and George Kittle. Kittle chugged two beers. Gronk would have done it better. Stephen A. Smith is there too. He once bought me lunch when I was an intern at the Inquirer. He is tough to watch on TV, but a good dude in real life.Fatu is out first with firebreathers. Very cool enterence. McIntyre has his trusty sword. I would think that would be legal, right? Might catch a murder charge, but WWE can't have a problem with it. They've washed their hands of this.Before he can, Fatu takes flight and hits a dive onto McIntyre. He still has his robe on and he's getting a beating. However very irresponsible of WWE to have all these weaposn under the ring. Fatu pulled out chairs, a tool box, chairs. The tool box has a bunch of tools in it. McIntyre fights back and throws Fatu's head into the apron. Then hits a slingshot into the apron. Jacob is in trouble.McIntyre sets up a table. He takes a selfie of him beating Fatu, then uses the phone to punch him. The phone belongs to Drew's brother. That was funny. Now he has a wrench and he's laughing. That's not good for Fatu. But Fatu hits a clothesline before McIntyre can use it. Then he hits a senton and a clothesline in the corner. He then hits 10 headbutts in the corner.Fatu just hit a popup Samoan drop and it was very impressive. But McIntyre fights back and he sets up a chair in the roder between the top and middle turnbuckle. McIntyre lookes for a claymore, but instead is driven headfirst into the chair. Fatu hits his moonsault, but Drew kicks out.McIntyre fights back and uses a wrench on Fatu's face. Ouch. Then he hits a suplex on two chairs. He didn't get it all, but it still hurt. Only got a two count. McIntyre takes a belt from the referee but before he can hit him, he eats a superkick. Now he's wearing McIntyre out with a steel chair. Then he gets the belt and takes it to Drew, whipping him about six times before dropping it. Now he's looking at the tool box, the same one McIntyre became familiar with when he wrestled CM Punk. Before Fatu can do anything, he eats a Claymore kick. McIntyre escapes at 2.They go toe to toe throwing punches. Then chps. Then slaps. Then punches again. Then head butts, although they were all from Fatu. Fatu hits a few tool box shots, then a moonsault through a table and he gets the win. The Usos, LA Knight vs. Austin Theory, Logan Paul, IShowSpeedWe're going viral with our first match as Austin Theory teams with two of the most popular influencers out there. Logan Paul is a legit wrestler, a future champion. IShowSpeed, we'll find out. Theory is great. But the other side has three wrestlers. Math tells me the good guys are going to win this, but it is WrestleMania, so who knows?I heard people complain LA Knight isn't in a marquee match, but I disagree. This match is on ESPN2. This is a match they clearly thinks can draw in fans. WrestleMania openers are usually great. I expect this to be great just because of all the talent in there.All six men are now in the ring, and we're ready to start. IShowSpeed is bigger than I thought. He's not huge, but he's got some size. The Usos superkick the tag team champs, and we start with LA Knight and Speed. Speed locks on a headlock, tries a flip and eats a clothesline. But he hits a body slam on Knight. Knight gets up and Speed tags in Paul, who is brought in the hard way!While I'm watching on ESPN Unlimited, it's kind of cool that wrestling is back on ESPN. I miss World Class or AWA being on every day when I'd get home from school.Paul is still in the ring and still getting whooped up on. The three good guys are taking turns beating up the tag champ. Paul makes the tag to theory, and the bad guys are now ganging up on big Jim! They tag in Speed, he goes for a suplex, but Jimmy was the one who nailed the suplex. Speed tags Paul in, Jimmy couldn't make a tag, so the bad guys in control.He was able to tag in his brother Jey, and Jey gets some nice moves in. He gets a spear on Theory, but Paul breaks it up.Now everyone is in the ring. Speed hits a headscissors on Jimmy. Knight goes for his finish on Speed, he pushes Knight into Paul, knocking him off. Then after getting yelled at by Theory, Knight shoves Theory into Speed. Knight hits his finish on Theory and that's it. WrestleMania opens with John CenaThe night opened with a bang. It started with WrestleMania host John Cena coming out. I think this is his first appearence in the ring since he lost to Gunther. He looks weird running in a suit. He didn't slide in. I think that's the first time he's entered the ring using steps. Cena is choking up it seems. Cool. Maybe he wasn't. But the fans are happy. He said the road to WrestleMania has been chaos and it's been very vocal. He said the time to deliver is now and we're all here to see who will step up and deliver. I'm guessing most of the stars. He welcomes us to WrestleMania, and now it's time for the show. Las Vegas Mass Choir sing God Bless AmericaThe night is getting started on a great note, with the Las Vegas Mass Choir singing God Bless America. They were awesome. Now it's time for the fighting. IShowSpeed is in troubleTonight's show starts with a six-man tag featuring the Usos and LA Knight (Yeah!) vs. Logan Paul, Austin Theory and IShowSpeed. We know he can take a beating, ask Bron Breakker about it, but he's not a trained professional. He could be in a lot of trouble. Get your drinks and popcornWe are officially 10 minutes away from the opener. So grab your snacks, put on your CM Punk shirt and lets get ready to rumble! Stadium looks fullIt looks like they have a nice crowd there. We'll find out tonight when someone announces it in an awkward way, but soon we'll find out how many people attended. Let's hope for a big crowd and a great night of wrestling. Has the buildup to WrestleMania 42 been good?A lot of people have complained about the buildup to WrestleMania. I don't get it. I've enjoyed it. The CM Punk vs. Roman Reigns promos have been incredible. But I also enjoy Pat McAfee getting involved in the Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton feud. As we sit one hour away from belltime, I'm excited. I'm more looking forward to Punk vs. Reigns, but tonight's card should be fun too.I just looked at the graphic, the two matches I'm looking forward to the most tonight -- Jacob Fatu vs. Drew McIntyre and Seth Rollins vs. Gunther -- are the only non-title matches tonight. The card is loaded, there are a lot of personal issues to settle, and every match has the potential to be a show stealer.I give the buildup high marks, and I think the stars will show us over the next 30 hours that the WWE didn't need Pat McAfee to make it better. But I still welcome him. Can I watch WrestleMania for free?If you have ESPN2, you can watch the first hour for free. The rest will be on ESPN Unlimited. However, you may already have it and not know. According to ESPN, "'"customers with Hulu + Live TV, DIRECTV, Fubo TV, Comcast Xfinity, Spectrum TV, Verizon FiOS, U-verse, Cox and other supported providers may already get ESPN Unlimited as part of their pay-TV package, with additional partners coming soon."If you have one of those companies as your provider, you just have to sign up for an account. Information available on the ESPN website on how to do it. Will Tom Brady be at WrestleManiaIf he will, it will be early. The best chance for Tom Brady to appear at WrestleMania would be during the opening match, where the Usos and LA Knight are taking on Austin Theory, IShowSpeed and Logan Paul, who Brady is beefing with. The two started talking trash before the flag football game, and Brady and Paul have continued to bicker since.With the card being held in Las Vegas, home of the Raiders, Brady could pop up. Let's go! What is an unsanctioned match in WWEThis match is an old school lights out match. It means WWE isn't responsible for what the men do to each other during the match. Probably sound decision, Jacob Fatu is scary and Drew McInytre is pretty rough dude too. This match could steal the show, and both men deserve to be in the main event picture. They'll show that to the world on ESPN today.When is WrestleMania 42?WrestleMania 42 will be held April 18 and 19.Where is WrestleMania 42?WrestleMania 42 will be held at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.What time will WrestleMania 42 start?WrestleMania 42 is slated to start at 6 p.m. each night.Where to watch WrestleMania 42The first hour of each night of WrestleMania 42 will air on cable. On Saturday, the first hour of the show will air on ESPN 2. On Sunday, the first hour will air on ESPN. The entire card will air on ESPN Unlimited.Who is hosting WrestleMania?John Cena will host WrestleMania 42.Night 1 cardCody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton for the Undisputed ChampionshipStephanie Vaquer vs. Liv Morgan for the WWE Women's World ChampionshipThe Usos and LA Knight vs. Austin Theory, Logan Paul and IShowSpeedDrew McIntyre vs. Jacob Fatu, unsanctioned matchSeth Rollins vs. GuntherAJ Lee vs. Becky Lynch for the Women's Intercontinental ChampionshipNIa Jax and Lash Legend vs. Charlotte Flair and Alexa Bliss vs. Bayley and Lyra Valkyria vs. the Bella Twins for the WWE Women's Tag Team championship.Night 2 cardCM Punk vs. Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight ChampionshipJade Cargill vs. Rhea Ripley for the WWE Women's ChampionshipBrock Lesnar vs. Oba FemiSami Zayn vs. Trick Williams for the United States ChampionshipPenta vs. Je'Von Evans vs. Dragon Lee vs. JD McDonagh vs. Rusev vs. Rey Mysterio in a ladder match for the WWE championshipFinn Balor vs. Dominik Mysterio
